title: Shipping Methods and Delivery Times
text: We offer standard and expedited shipping. Standard shipping takes 5-7 business days and is free on all domestic orders over $50. Expedited shipping delivers in 2-3 business days for an additional fee of $15. International shipping is available to over 50 countries worldwide via DHL, FedEx, and UPS with delivery times ranging between 7-14 business days.

title: Accepted Payment Methods and Security
text: We accept major credit cards including Visa, MasterCard, American Express, as well as PayPal, Apple Pay, and Google Pay. All transactions are protected by 256-bit SSL encryption and comply with PCI-DSS Level 1 standards. We retry failed payments up to 3 times over 48 hours before cancellation.
